## What

Brief description of the change.

## Why

Link the issue this PR addresses. Include `Fixes #123` to close it when merged.
See the [contributing guide](https://github.com/OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#bugs-and-features) for the claim and review process.

For feature work, link the issue with core-team approval recorded after discussion on a contributor call and before implementation or PR review.

## How

Key implementation decisions, trade-offs, or areas reviewers should focus on.
Call out intentional omissions (especially vs older TypeScript behavior) when relevant.

## Testing

How you validated this locally (commands, scenarios, screenshots if UI).

## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `main` (or continuing an existing PR branch)
- [ ] One focused change; links the related issue and uses `Fixes #N` when it should close the issue
- [ ] Feature work has core-team approval recorded in the issue after discussion and before implementation or PR review
- [ ] Follows [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator/blob/main/AGENTS.md) conventions and PR hygiene
- [ ] Tests added/updated for user-visible behavior where it makes sense
- [ ] Relevant CI checks pass for the area touched (`go`, frontend, etc.)
